grain_rationale: row_count is 13014 with duplicate_row_rate 0.0, so no exact duplicate rows exist to absorb. airport_code has distinct_count 3 and observed_hour_utc has distinct_count 4341 (3*4341=13023, close to 13014 allowing for a few missing hours), so neither column alone is unique (neither distinct_count equals row_count) but the pair identifies one hourly observation per airport, making this a transaction-grain fact with a derived identity over (airport_code, observed_hour_utc).

fields.name: airport_code
fields.description: Three-letter code identifying the NYC airport (EWR, JFK, LGA) where the observation was taken; distinct_count 3, null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: observed_hour_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp of the hourly weather observation (e.g. 2013-01-01T06:00:00), distinct_count 4341, null_rate 0.0; samples resolve to the top of each hour so the finest grain is hour.

fields.name: observed_date_local
fields.description: Local calendar date of the observation (e.g. 2013-01-01), distinct_count 181 spanning the six-month window, null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: observed_hour_local
fields.description: Local hour-of-day (0-23) of the observation, distinct_count 24, null_rate 0.0; labels the hour rather than measuring a quantity.

fields.name: temp_f
fields.description: Air temperature in degrees Fahrenheit ranging 10.94 to 93.92 per operator context units, null_rate 0.0, an additive/aggregable quantity.

fields.name: dewpoint_f
fields.description: Dew point temperature in degrees Fahrenheit ranging -9.94 to 73.94, null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: humidity_pct
fields.description: Relative humidity percent ranging 12.74 to 100.0, null_rate 0.0, distinct_count 2178 indicating fine-grained measurement.

fields.name: wind_dir_degrees
fields.description: Wind direction in compass degrees (0-360), null_rate 0.016828 (219 nulls) presumably when wind was calm or unmeasured; a directional label rather than an additive measure.

fields.name: wind_speed_mph
fields.description: Wind speed in mph ranging 0.0 to 1048.36058, null_rate 0.000154 (2 nulls).

fields.name: wind_gust_mph
fields.description: Wind gust speed in mph ranging 16.11092 to 62.14212, null_rate 0.745505 (9702 nulls) since gusts appear only to be recorded when they occur.

fields.name: precip_inches
fields.description: Precipitation in inches ranging 0.0 to 1.06, null_rate 0.0, aggregable across observations.

fields.name: pressure_mb
fields.description: Barometric pressure in millibars ranging 983.8 to 1038.4, null_rate 0.114953 (1496 nulls) when the station did not report pressure.

fields.name: visibility_miles
fields.description: Visibility in miles ranging 0.0 to 10.0 with distinct_count 20 (listed under the profiler's distinct-value cap), null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_name
fields.description: Full airport name (e.g. John F. Kennedy International Airport), distinct_count 3, null_rate 0.0, joined from OurAirports per operator context with declared-complete join coverage.

fields.name: airport_municipality
fields.description: Municipality of the airport (New York or Newark), distinct_count 2, null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_elevation_ft
fields.description: Airport elevation in feet (13, 18, or 21), distinct_count 3, null_rate 0.0; a static per-airport attribute, not a per-observation measure.

fields.name: airport_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Longest runway length in feet for the airport (7002, 11000, or 14511), distinct_count 3, null_rate 0.0; a static per-airport attribute.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Pipeline capture timestamp (e.g. 2026-09-02T23:26:11) with only 3 distinct values across 13014 rows and null_rate 0.0; reflects ingestion batching rather than the weather event time.

category_description: One row represents a single hourly weather observation at one of the three NYC airports (EWR, JFK, LGA), combining the nycflights13 hourly readings with the airport's static OurAirports name, municipality, elevation, and runway attributes.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver.silver_airport_weather table enters the gold unified event star as the airport_weather_observations fact category, naming the time column, grain, and field roles for the deterministic modeling engine that renders the gold models.
usage: The proposal is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema and gated by datacontract lint, then reviewed and edited by a human before approval; only the approved contract drives the modeling engine.
limitations: The mapping does not filter, deduplicate, or reconcile rows (duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across 13014 rows so none exist to resolve), does not explain why wind_gust_mph is null 74.55% of the time or why wind_dir_degrees, wind_speed_mph, and pressure_mb carry smaller null rates beyond what the profile shows, and leaves any downstream null-handling or quality rules for those columns to consumers.
